content: Affekta has a NASA contract that focuses on enabling safe Earth Independent Operations such as manned missions to the Moon and Mars. We seek to hire Lean experts with emphasis on improving and verifying the safety and resilience of our Lean theorems based Fault Discovery, Isolation and Recovery with a focus on "unknown unknowns" system for astronauts life support. Interested email CV and cover letter to hedinn@affekta.com.
hey -- curious why Lean4 when 001 was built for this exact problem statement 40 years ago

Because Lean is extendable. 001 works for anomalies that are known at design time. For unexpected anomalies we need out of distribution generalization. When astronauts land on the Moon, the only thing that we can be sure about is that there will be surprises. With genuine OOD domain transfer capabilities we can face all unknowns.

Hi Hedin, this looks very interesting. I have CubeSat payload engineering experience from Thailand, including a GISTDA CubeSat competition background and my own engineering model work.

I’m currently focusing on Lean/formal methods and I’m especially interested in safety-critical autonomous systems, FDIR, and OOD robustness.

I’ll send my CV and a short cover letter by email. Thanks for sharing this opportunity.
(Just a public service announcement --- please don't "reply all" in the job postings streams, zulip mods will probably delete such replies in future.)
